testProjects.name: AlembicWorkspace
testProjects.role: Alembic 系列仓库 multi-root / self-hosting 集成验证目标
testProjects.defaultUse: ProjectScope、Plugin、Dashboard、Alembic 自身跨仓库链路复测
testProjects.protection: 按总控工作区和真实测试项目双重保护；Test 不提交 workspace 仓库，不把根目录加入 source folders，除测试单明确授权外不改产品源码

testProjects.name: BiliDili
testProjects.role: 真实 iOS/Swift 业务项目验证目标
testProjects.defaultUse: 冷启动、resident search、prime、真实项目只读扫描和最小回归
testProjects.protection: 默认只读；不得为测试便利修改业务代码、登录、播放、网络、UI 或 Xcode 项目结构

codexMcpReload.defaultUse: refresh installed plugin projection and run a fresh MCP probe; it does not live-reload the current Codex host MCP session
codexMcpReload.codexProbeAllowedUse: collect fresh MCP evidence only when the active test order assigns Codex Plugin or host-environment verification to Test
codexMcpReload.realProjectRouteBoundary: do not use the Codex Plugin or host-environment smoke route as a substitute for real-project cold-start/rescan, AI/provider, Dashboard, monitoring, or regression validation
forbiddenInTest: do not use reload as a repair path for current Transport closed
do not pass --stop-mcp or watch --restart-mcp unless the control plan explicitly authorizes current host MCP loss and a Codex restart
